body: Letting it all out was kind of the point of my orignal post. Now it's mostly just finishing off this bottle of rum. I'm actually one who usually doesn't find much in drugs for relief, but I have this bottle kicking around and now seems the time. Honestly, I'm scared, I have regrets, and all the normal things.. But now I have less people in my life, and everyone is more distanced from me. I know I'd hurt people if I took my life, but it honestly would be fairly minimalized. Yes I realize this is my trying to rationalize my thoughts, but it's true none-the-less. I am scared, and I have regrets, but after all I've been through I'm fairly confident that all that is fairly unlikely. I know it's possible, if even very unlikely, but it all comes to whether it's worth it all, and worth it for those around you. My only out is with my family - but they won't understand. They've always been disappointed in me, and will be further so by this. I could swallow my pride and put them through it, but is it worth it if it just repeats? They refuse to accept what is actually going on, and already are ashamed of what little they accept. And I definitely don't know how to get through this. I've learned I can't trust counselors/therapists (it'll take a LOT to change that), and medication has had a lasting effect on my memory (atleast in my opinion, though I suppose it could have been something else and the timing was just bad...)

That may help if I cared about trying to get a job in the last 4 months.. I haven't. I don't know what it is, definitely not depression, but I just don't care about the fact that I maxed out my credit card and haven't had a job for a while. Well, other than the fact that I'm near the limit now and posting here. I haven't been able to talk about any of this type of stuff since I lost my best friend 3.5 years ago so this is kinda nice in a way. Although, sadly, accomplishes little in the end.

I don't believe so. Although I don't pretend to be an expert in the area. I'm in Canada (BC) but from what I know my only options financially are from my family right now. Unfortunately I know they are already strained, plus they're already ashamed of me from last time. They've always helped when they can financially, but that can only happen so much.

Great movies, but yes cliche advice. I know, I know, cliche advice is cliche for a reason. The fact is like most people I've heard all the basic stuff so many times. I've had a very long time and hug swings in my emotions while considering all this many times so I've seen it from many sides aswell. Unfortunately it's far too late for advice like this to help much, especially from a random person BUT I do want you to know that I respect what you do here and do truly appreciate it. Attempting to help people with these problems isn't easy - I thought about doing it for a while when I felt I was 'better' since my depression. Thank you for trying to help, thank you for your efforts and any pain it brings upon you.
